facts.statement: The --setup-show option enables displaying fixture setup while tests execute.

During fixture setup, when setup-show is enabled and the request has a parameter, pytest stores either a callable/list-derived fixture ID or, when no IDs exist, the raw request.param value in fixturedef.cached_param.
The setup-show renderer inserts fixturedef.cached_param into "[{}]" using str.format, which invokes string conversion for a bytes value.
The cached parameter is rendered during teardown as well as setup, and is deleted only after the teardown rendering call.
Existing setup-display coverage exercises raw string fixture parameters and expects their values in both setup and teardown output.
Existing setup-display coverage separately exercises explicit string IDs supplied as a list and generated by a callable.
The repository already provides saferepr, which returns a size-limited representation and is documented to handle exceptions raised by object repr implementations.
Another parameter-ID validation path in pytest already uses saferepr when including an invalid ID value in an error message.

scope_summary: Base commit 5e7f1ab4bf58e473e5d7f878eb2b499d7deabd29 contains a setup-show rendering path that retains raw parameter values and interpolates them with str-style formatting; existing setup-only tests cover string parameters and explicit IDs but not bytes under BytesWarning.
